column1: # The languages of each region in cloud/regions.tsv (one row per registry id;
# tests/test_region_languages.py checks that every registry row has one).
# languages = the region's own languages, most used first, comma-separated
# ISO 639 codes (ISO 639-1 where there is one): what its signs and OSM's
# `name` tags are written in. A multi-country region lists its countries'
# official languages, largest first. A language-ready build
# map-config.json as regionLanguages; nothing else reads it yet.
